cases.question: How many expenses did my direct reports submit in each month of 2026? Show the month number (1-12) and the count.
cases.sql:
SELECT 
    m.month_number,
    COALESCE(e.expense_count, 0) AS expense_count
FROM 
    (SELECT LEVEL AS month_number FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12) m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM submitted_at) AS month_number,
        COUNT(*) AS expense_count
    FROM 
        hr.expenses
    WHERE 
        employee_id IN (
            SELECT employee_id
            FROM hr.employees
            WHERE manager_email = 'vmehta'
        )
        AND submitted_at BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-10-20'
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM submitted_at)
) e ON m.month_number = e.month_number
ORDER BY 
    m.month_number
cases.answer: In 2026, your direct reports submitted expenses as follows: January (19), February (25), March (26), April (19), May (33), June (34), July (30), August (37), September (24), October (19), and no expenses in November and December.
